justification: Inspected javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/visitor/VoidVisitor.java (246 lines, 103 visit signatures) plus VoidVisitorWithDefaults.java and VoidVisitorAdapter.java. VoidVisitor is a pure interface with no fields or behavior; it only declares one visit method per AST node type as a cohesive visitor contract, while the traversal/default logic is separated into the other two classes. That structure does not show the class itself as insufficiently modularized.
